name: TestDesignAgent
description: Derives test cases with named techniques (EP, BVA, decision table, state transition, pairwise, use case, CRUD, error guessing, role matrix), prioritises them by risk and selects them within the coverage profile's budget; writes test_cases.json for ScriptGeneration.

inputs.name: test_design
inputs.description: Resolved test_generation profile/budget/design_llm block (from project.yaml via the manifest); read from project.yaml when absent

inputs.name: requirements
inputs.description: Resolved requirements block; requirements.enabled must be true

outputs.name: status
outputs.description: success | partial (LLM degraded or budget exceeded by P0/floor cases)

outputs.name: skipped
outputs.description: true when no profile is set or requirements are off

outputs.name: summary
outputs.description: Generated / selected / cut counts, by technique, priority and type, AC coverage

outputs.name: output.locator_keys_added
outputs.description: locator_map.json keys added for crawled-page form fields
